text:
leo: Heads-up  we need a tight one-pager (two versions: customer-facing PDF + short landing snippet) that explains when to pick Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for enterprise buyers. Aim: SDRs can hand it to AE, and the webinar signup can use two benchmark callouts.

sana: Got it. Keep it very scannable. Suggested sections: 2-line value prop, decision matrix (when to pick each), 2 benchmark tiles (latency + cost), security bullets, CTA to webinar + contact link.

leo: Exactly. Also include a small "for engineers" box: sample prompt, expected behavior, recommended knobs. Wants it live by Friday.

 tom: Pulling benchmark numbers from last infra run. Proposed copy numbers: p50 gen latency ~95ms (Dedicated, 1024 context), p95 ~290ms (Hosted during burst), embedding latency ~18ms. Cost callouts: hosted default ~$0.22 / 1k tokens, tuned stack (dedicated + quant + batching) ~$0.038 / 1k tokens. Add confidence tags (approx).

sana: Nice. For messaging, two short webinar hooks: "Choose the right path: performance, cost, and control" and "How customers cut inference surprises with predictable SLAs". Landing needs a tiny signup form and 2 bullet takeaways.

leo: For inbound routing: we need deterministic rules so security-sensitive leads go straight to field. Proposed HubSpot rules (simple):

```
- tag=security-priority if body contains: HIPAA, PCI, FedRAMP, SOC2
- tag=private-request if body contains: on-prem, air-gapped, VPC, "no-cloud"
- set=lead_hot if ARR_est >= 100k OR company_size >= 2000
- route_to=AE_queue if tag=security-priority OR lead_hot=true
- fallback=SDR_queue
```

leo: Add a note: include a webhook payload to eng-solutions with sample request for immediate follow-up.

deploy-bot: routing rules staged (id rs-2026-11-14-09). Unit tests: 18/18 passed.

tom: UX suggestion on the one-pager: two tiny benchmark tiles side-by-side with microcopy: "p50 gen latency: ~95ms (Dedicated)" and "Per-1k token cost: ~$0.038 (Optimized)". Use small footnote: workloads and prompt size vary.

sana: I'll write the copy and lay out the PDF. Can we include a single customer quote? Recommended: short ops-focused line from a pilot: "Switched to Dedicated, cut tail latency and got predictable billing"  signpost: -ACME Health (pilot).

leo: Add two tiny FAQ bullets: "How do SLAs differ by mode?" (hosted: best-effort with burst; dedicated: contract SLAs; private: custom SLA + network isolation) and "Is there a rollback path?" (yes  automatic model variant fallback + canary).

tom: Engineer checklist (1-liner each): sample prompt (customer chat 64 tokens), expected latency band (Dedicated 60-140ms p50, Hosted 120-400ms p95), tuning knobs (batch size, KV cache, quant level), recommended model family.

sana: Will mock PDF + landing HTML. Posting draft link in thread when ready. ETA: Thursday EOD for draft, Friday AM review.

leo: Routing automation is critical  thanks. Once draft is up, tag eng-sales and solutions for a quick read. :eyes:
